analytics.name: Analytic 1657
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Unix Shell from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Command Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: Unix shell process (sh, bash, busybox sh, toybox) spawns as child of app process with command-line arguments indicating scripted operation — shell with arguments confirms script execution not interactive terminal]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [Application invokes Runtime.exec(), ProcessBuilder.start(), or JNI-backed launcher with sh, bash, toybox, toolbox, or su as command argument NOT IN $ApprovedShellApps$ — explicit Unix shell invocation]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Terminal emulator apps (developer fleet only). Production managed devices: empty — no app should spawn Unix shells. Derive from IT device classification.
Default 30s between shell spawn and follow-on file/network activity.
